name: Special Meeting Memo
agenda_text:
The City of San Diego
Office of Council President Joe LaCava
First District
M e m o r a n d u m
date: January 12, 2026
to: Honorable City Councilmembers
from: Council President Joe LaCava, District 1
subject: Adjournment of Regular Meeting and Special Meeting for State of the City
________________________________________________________________________________________________________
The meeting scheduled for the 2026 State of the City on Thursday, January 15, 2026, at 3:00pm is adjourned. In its stead, the San Diego City Council will convene for a Special Meeting on Thursday, January 15, 2026, at 1:00pm or shortly thereafter, on the 12 th floor of the City Administration Building, at 202 C Street, San Diego, CA 92101, to hear the following item:
Mayor Todd Gloria's 2026 State of the City Address
Public comment for this item will be taken at 1:00 pm , or shortly thereafter, in the City Council Committee Room.
After the conclusion of public comment, the Council will recess and reconvene at 3:00 pm , or shortly thereafter, in City Council Chambers for the State of the City Address.
If you have questions, please contact Luz Anaya Luna, Director of Legislative Affairs, at 619-235-5880 or lanayaluna@sandiego.gov and Heidi Palmer, Legislative Analyst, at 619-533-3920 or palmerh@sandiego.gov .
cc: Honorable Mayor Todd Gloria
Honorable City Attorney Heather Ferbert
Diana Fuentes, City Clerk
Charles Modica, Independent Budget Analyst
